original_finding.location: Proof step 4.1, asymptotic velocities and their speed.
original_finding.evidence: Proof step 2.1 defines c=sqrt(2E/mu). For the repulsive Coulomb potential and finite rho, the energy identity gives |rho'|^2=c^2−2kappa/(mu rho)−J^2/(mu rho^2)<c^2, so step 4.1's |rho'|>=c is false. The associated assertion rho(t)>=c|t| up to an additive constant is also not justified for the long-range Coulomb tail. The limit |rho'|→c gives |rho'|>=c0 for any fixed 0<c0<c at sufficiently large |t|, which suffices for the integrable acceleration estimate. Replace c in the lower-bound argument by such a c0. Nonfatal because the asymptotic-velocity conclusion follows after this one-line repair. original_finding.evidence: Step 2.1 defines `c=√(2E/μ)`. The energy identity in [L1] gives, at every finite `ρ`, `|ρ'|²=c²−2κ/(μρ)−J²/(μρ²)<c²` because `κ,J>0`. Thus step 4.1's assertion `|ρ'|≥c` is false. The asserted lower bound `ρ(t)≥c|t|` up to an additive constant is also not established; the limit `|ρ'|→c` only supplies an eventual lower bound using a fixed `c₀<c`.

original_finding.location: Statement clause (a), sentence beginning “consequently T_l extends uniquely to a linear isometry”
original_finding.evidence: T_l is defined on compactly supported L² sources, but clause (a) says it extends to a map whose domain is the positive spectral subspace; the compact-source domain is not a subset of that subspace. The proof instead extends T_l to a contraction on all of L² and restricts it to the positive spectral subspace. Define the induced map on the projected compact-source core, or state T_l = widehat T_l E_{A_l}((0,∞)), to make the extension precise. The assigned two-body consumer uses this supplier’s spectral representation.
